title: Concept: Firebase realtime database URL in a response
description: A Firebase realtime-database host name in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: A database host in a page points an attacker at the project; unless the rules deny reads, appending .json to the host returns the entire tree.
applicability: Prototypes, support tools and client bundles that still use the realtime database.
risk: A permissive ruleset turns the host into a full data dump of every collection in the project.
